Hireboard workspace

Root context for the Hireboard workspace. This folder has no .git on purpose: api/ and web/ are separate repositories. Start Claude here for cross-repo work. The imports below pull in each repo's own context; this file holds only what neither repo knows alone.

@api/CLAUDE.md @web/CLAUDE.md

Product

Hireboard is a small job board. Visitors search open job postings and read company careers pages. Candidates keep a private profile, apply to jobs and review companies. Employers see applications to their own company's jobs. Admins moderate every review before it goes public.

  • Product brief, roles, scope and non-goals: product-brief.md
  • Business rules (canonical, validated by Maya Chen): api/docs/context/business-rules.md. Specs cite rules by ID (BR-xx) and invariants by ID (INV-xx).
  • Decisions: api/docs/adr/ (ADR-0001: SPA auth through the Next.js server)

Invariants

These hold across both repos. A change that breaks one needs an ADR first.

ID Invariant
INV-01 The API lives under /api/v1. Success envelope {success, status, message, data[, meta]}; paginated meta is {current_page, per_page, total, last_page}. Error envelope {success: false, status, message, code[, errors]}.
INV-02 Single-action invokable controllers, business logic in services, DTOs (App\DTOs, Spatie Laravel Data v4) across layers, repositories behind App\Contracts interfaces.
INV-03 Domain tables use UUID keys; users keeps bigint ids (Sanctum token morphs stay unchanged).
INV-04 Timestamps are stored in UTC and serialized as ISO-8601.
INV-05 The browser never holds the API token. The Next.js server keeps it in the HttpOnly cookie hireboard_session (ADR-0001).
INV-06 Every endpoint the browser calls is listed in web/lib/api/endpoints.ts and api/docs/api/api-contracts.md.
INV-07 Salaries are integers (annual, whole currency units) plus an ISO-4217 currency.

Layout

Folder Repo Stack Gates
api/ git@github.com:hireboard/api.git Laravel 12 JSON API (PHP 8.3, Sanctum, Pest 3, SQLite in dev) see api/AGENTS.md
web/ git@github.com:hireboard/web.git Next.js 15 App Router (BFF, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, Vitest) see web/AGENTS.md

Contract

  • The API contract lives in api/docs/api/api-contracts.md. The backend is authoritative. When the frontend and the contract disagree, the frontend is wrong.
  • Every backend endpoint the browser calls is registered in web/lib/api/endpoints.ts (INV-06). Pages and server actions call the API only through web/lib/api/client.ts.
  • Frontend types mirror backend DTO output (toApiArray() and friends) in web/types/api/. Enum literals must match the backend enum values exactly (UserRole, EmploymentType, JobPostingStatus, ReviewStatus).
  • Error codes (job_not_found, already_applied, ...) are part of the contract. The web forms map them to messages, so a renamed code is a breaking change.
  • Check drift with web/scripts/contract-sync.mjs: it compares php artisan route:list --json from api/ with the registry and fails on a mismatch. CI runs it on every web PR (web/.github/workflows/contract-sync.yml). Don't trust endpoint counts written in any doc.

Cross-repo routing

If you change Read first Then update
A DTO's output (toApiArray(), toOwnerArray(), ...) api/app/DTOs/ + api/docs/api/api-contracts.md web/types/api/*.ts, the fetcher in web/lib/api/, affected pages
A route path, method or auth middleware api/routes/api/v1/*.php web/lib/api/endpoints.ts, api/docs/api/api-contracts.md, web/middleware.ts matcher
Validation rules or field names the input DTO in api/app/DTOs/ the matching form component and its server action error mapping
A domain error code api/app/Exceptions/*Exception.php the server action that maps ApiError.code to a message
An enum api/app/Enums/ the literal union in web/types/api/, labels and filters
Auth or session flow ADR-0001, api/app/Services/AuthService.php web/lib/session.ts, web/middleware.ts, web/app/(auth)/actions.ts, in matching branches
A table or column api/docs/schemas/*.md (schema-first) migration, model, factory, then the DTOs above
A business rule api/docs/context/business-rules.md the specs that cite it; ask Maya Chen first

Rule of thumb: if a backend change could be visible to the browser, assume the frontend has to change too. Grep web/ before you call the backend task done.

Process

  • Tickets use the HIRE prefix. No tracker is connected: paste the ticket text into /sdd.
  • Commit in each repo separately (git -C api ..., git -C web ...). Never run git from this root.
  • Use the same branch name in both repos for one change: <feature|fix|chore>/HIRE-<n>-<slug>, for example feature/HIRE-4-company-reviews. One PR per repo; link them to each other.
  • Commit subjects follow Conventional Commits (the kit's commit hook enforces it).
  • Features go /sdd -> write-spec -> approval by Maya Chen in the same /sdd conversation -> ship-feature or /execute-task. Pass both repos to workflows: { repos: { backend: "api", frontend: "web" }, url: "http://localhost:3000" }.
  • Each repo's gates run in that repo. A failure in one blocks the change.
  • Merge order: api first when the change is additive. Use expand/contract when it breaks the contract: add the new shape, move web over, then remove the old shape.

Where outputs land

Workflows and skills write relative to the directory the session started in.

  • Specs live in the repo that starts the change, usually api/.ai/specs/spec-HIRE-<n>-<slug>/ (a web-only change uses web/.ai/specs/). Workflows accept a repo-relative folder from this root: spec: "api/.ai/specs/spec-HIRE-4-company-reviews". /execute-task --spec= and /deep-review --spec= resolve only against ./.ai/specs of the session directory and do not accept a repo-relative path, so run them from a session started inside the owning repo, where --spec=HIRE-5 or the full folder name resolves.

  • Root .ai/ is local scratch and is never committed (this folder has no git): anything a skill writes while the session runs from the root lands here. /execute-task state and verification reports land in the owning repo's .ai/, because /execute-task runs there.

  • One-file outputs you want committed (tech-research ADR in docs/adr/, a qa-and-docs plan in docs/qa/, /deep-review reports in .ai/reviews/): start the session inside the owning repo so the file lands in that repo:

    cd api && CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1 claude --add-dir ../web
cd web && CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1 claude --add-dir ../api

    In such a session the repos are "." and "../web" (or "." and "../api"), not api/web.

Environment

  • API: http://localhost:8000 (cd api && php artisan serve --port=8000).
  • Web: http://localhost:3000 (cd web && npm run dev). This is the url for every workflow.
  • The web server reads the API URL from web/.env.local: API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000. Never expose it as NEXT_PUBLIC_*: the browser never calls :8000 directly (INV-05), so the API needs no CORS config.
  • Local data: cd api && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed. Local only, never against a shared database. Demo accounts (password password): candidate@hireboard.test, employer@acme.test, admin@hireboard.test.
